review.shorterRoute: The native finite torsion-submodule annihilator theorem applies directly because the original integral H1 is finite over Z and Z is Noetherian. Apply it to H1 / parabolicH1, then Bezout proves saturation for every scalar coprime to one fixed nonzero integer. Combine with the existing exact full-H1 reduction kernel. This avoids new cusp-width, polynomial unipotent cokernel or Smith-normal-form developments.
review.scope: Only the generic saturation lemma is promoted because the actual Hecke-span congruence directly consumes it. The separately audited SourceParabolicReductionKernel theorem remains archived scratch work and is deferred; it is not required by the shorter route. No source theorem or acceptance gate is weakened.
